learning_outcomes.text: Explain the role of cost estimating and quantity surveying across a project
Take off quantities from drawings using a consistent method
Build up unit rates from labour, plant, material and overhead
Prepare and interpret a bill of quantities and a cost plan
Apply contingency, inflation and risk allowances honestly
Value work done, manage variations and report cost against budget

integrative_case: A quantity surveyor must price and control a small school extension: take off quantities from the drawings, build up rates into a bill, set an honest contingency, then value monthly progress and variations and report true cost against the budget to the client.
assesses: knowledge and applied reasoning on every in-scope outcome via MCQ/MR
case-based decisions in the integrative case
